what_1_9_fixes.symptom: 1.8 reported registered=12 found=42 skipped=30 on the same console; PRAGMATA PPSA02530 among them, with its 35,776,561,152 byte app.pkg untouched on the M.2 the whole time.
what_1_9_fixes.cause: The destination guard required an ownership marker AND an empty directory. /data/ps5_storage_restore/owned/ had been cleared, so the marker test could never pass and every leftover empty mount point under /user/app/ was permanently unusable - which is the state a lost database leaves behind.
what_1_9_fixes.measured: 28 of the 30 blocked destinations were empty directories; 0 markers existed.
what_1_9_fixes.change: An empty directory is accepted regardless of the marker. A directory that still holds files is refused unless the marker proves it is ours.
